data.revised_prompt:
High-fidelity desktop web app composition, 1536x1024 landscape, for Glacier Signal Chinese A-share evaluation page. Use the approved reference’s visual language: carrier navy background, coupon white paper, carbon purple panels, jet red stamps, condensed airline-grotesk typography, perforations, clipped corners, carbon-copy texture, professional ticket-wallet identity. Create a distinct layout variation, not a copy of the reference.

Interface structure:
- Compact product header at top, calm and production-grade, with the product name “Glacier Signal” visible.
- First viewport dominated by one oversized vertical release coupon slightly left of center. This main coupon is the hero verdict panel and should feel like a real operating interface, not a poster.
- On the hero coupon, clearly show: “贵州茅台”, “600519.SH”, “数据日 2026-08-24”, “等待转强”, and “候选评分 71 / 100”. Make the status the strongest element.
- A bold red pending-validation stamp crosses only the status area, using both words and icon-like stamp treatment, with red plus subtle color cue. Do not cover the stock name or score.
- Left side: a narrow detachable checklist strip with automatic hard filters and two user confirmations. Include the exact visible Chinese text “自动检查”, “事件风险”, and “交易动机”. Make it look like a torn-off checklist coupon strip with perforations.
- Right side: a carbon-purple risk receipt panel showing account inputs, “结构止损 ¥1,198.00”, recommended shares, maximum loss, and a visible action button-like row “查看近两年回测”. Keep it real and restrained; no invented market fields.
- Below the hero row, quieter coupon rows begin with technical scoring modules, aligned like ticket stubs, with sections that read like production metrics rather than cards.
- The verdict must be unmistakably the primary task output.

Visible text to include exactly and legibly: “Glacier Signal”, “贵州茅台”, “600519.SH”, “数据日 2026-08-24”, “等待转强”, “候选评分 71 / 100”, “自动检查”, “事件风险”, “交易动机”, “结构止损 ¥1,198.00”, “查看近两年回测”.

Composition/style requirements:
- Dense but calm, accessible, professional, premium enterprise UI.
- No device frame, no watermark, no airplane or airport imagery, no neon terminal aesthetic, no generic financial cards.
- Preserve ticket perforations, clipped corners, carbon-copy texture, paper grain, and navy/purple/red palette.
- Use clear hierarchy, subtle gridlines, dashed separators, and stamp marks. Include icons with status text where appropriate.
- Make the hero coupon oversized and slightly left of center; right panel narrower and purple; left checklist strip narrow and detachable.
- Use realistic Chinese financial UI spacing and typography, crisp and highly legible, with a genuine desktop web app look.
- Keep the page grounded in real product truth and avoid irrelevant claims.

The result should look like a polished production screenshot of a web app evaluation page rendered as ticket-like paper components, with the verdict panel dominating the view and the lower modules quieter than the hero card.

Avoid: exact layout duplication of reference, poster composition, dark sci-fi neon, excessive glow, extra stock fields, airport motifs, mobile UI, device bezel, watermark, or random decorative icons unrelated to the operating interface.

Overall: elegant, high-fidelity, enterprise desktop dashboard built from paper-ticket components, with the pending verdict as the main focal point and the Chinese text fully legible and accurate.
